title: Even part on the Boolean cube
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a real-valued function $f$ on the $(n+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube, define its even part on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube by taking, at each $x$, half the sum of the slices of $f$ with first coordinate $1$ and first coordinate $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube
